Class RemoteServerServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
org.adsl.server.network.rmi.RemoteServerServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, RemoteServerService
public class RemoteServerServiceImpl extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RemoteServerService
RMI server-side endpoint. Exported as a UnicastRemoteObject and bound in the RMI registry under the name "GameServer".

Each incoming RMI call (connect(RemoteClientStub), sendRequest(ClientRequest, RemoteClientStub), disconnect(RemoteClientStub)) is dispatched on a shared cached thread pool so that RMI worker threads are not blocked by game logic.

Ordering note: RMI requests from the same client are submitted to the shared pool sequentially (one submit per call), which preserves arrival order for a single client stub. Cross-client ordering is not guaranteed.
